Thursday and Friday afternoons. Both are fully free, so you can pick any contiguous 2-hour slot (for example 1–3 or 2–4).

Other options if you want specific 2-hour windows:
- Wednesday 1–3 is free (you have a 3–4 one‑on‑one).
- Monday 12–2 is free (you have 9–11 and a 2–4 vendor call).

I didn't change anything — just planning on paper. Which two-hour slots do you prefer?
